title: Oxygen-evolving complex
extract: The oxygen-evolving complex is the active site of a water-oxidizing enzyme involved in photosynthesis. The active site consists of a cluster of manganese and calcium cofactors. In this local edge-case snippet, ethanol is noted as being excluded from the reaction zone besides water.
